note: Questions derived from real help-center article titles. Reference answers condensed from article bodies. Key facts are hard strings used for deterministic fact checks.

questions.question: How do I claim the free SSL certificate that comes with my Hostinger hosting plan?
questions.reference: On Web, Cloud, or Agency hosting plans, a free SSL certificate is automatically installed as soon as you add a domain, create a subdomain, or park a domain. You can also install it manually via the Lifetime SSL option in hPanel. The free Lifetime SSL only works for websites hosted at Hostinger; certificate files cannot be downloaded or installed elsewhere.

questions.question: My website shows ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR. How do I fix it?
questions.reference: First make sure the domain is pointed to Hostinger and wait up to 24 hours for DNS propagation. Then: open the site in an incognito window to rule out browser cache; verify domain pointing with a DNS checker tool; verify the certificate with an SSL checker tool. If you use a custom SSL, contact your SSL vendor. For Lifetime SSL on WordPress or custom PHP/HTML sites, uninstall the existing certificate and install a new one. Also try temporarily disabling antivirus or firewall software.

questions.question: How do I enable or disable HTTPS for my website at Hostinger?
questions.reference: Once an SSL certificate is installed on a Web or Cloud hosting plan, HTTPS is forced by default. To disable it, go to the Websites section in hPanel, click Dashboard next to the site, find SSL in the sidebar, click the ellipsis button next to the domain and select Unforce HTTPS. To re-enable, choose Force HTTPS on the same page. Forcing/unforcing HTTPS is not available on Agency hosting plans.

questions.question: My browser says 'Not Secure' or 'Your connection is not private' on my Hostinger site. What should I do?
questions.reference: Work through these causes: make sure the website is published (AI Builder sites must be published at least once); confirm the domain is pointed to Hostinger using nameservers or the correct A/CNAME records; wait up to 24 hours for DNS propagation and test in incognito; check www vs non-www consistency; manually visit https://yourdomain to test, then force HTTPS in hPanel; look for mixed content (HTTP resources on an HTTPS page); for ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR specifically, uninstall and reinstall the SSL certificate.

questions.question: What MX records do I need for Hostinger Email?
questions.reference: Your domain's DNS zone must contain Hostinger's MX records. You can find the exact values in hPanel under Emails, then Mailboxes next to your account, then Domain settings. If your domain uses Hostinger nameservers, click Connect automatically. If it points elsewhere, add the records manually and delete any existing MX records first. Allow a few hours for DNS propagation.

questions.question: What is the SPF record for Hostinger Email?
questions.reference: The default SPF record for Hostinger Email is a TXT record with the value: v=spf1 include:_spf.mail.hostinger.com ~all. You must have only one SPF record on your domain; if you also use another email service, merge both values into a single record, e.g. v=spf1 include:_spf.mail.hostinger.com include:emailmktprovider.tld ~all. Allow a few hours for DNS propagation.

questions.question: How do I set up my Hostinger Email on an email app like Outlook or Thunderbird? What are the server settings?
questions.reference: Find your configuration details in hPanel under Emails, click Manage next to your domain, then Connect Apps & Devices. For the outgoing SMTP server use host smtp.hostinger.com with TLS or STARTTLS encryption on port 587. Log in with your complete email address and your mailbox password.

questions.question: My Hostinger Email is not working at all. How do I troubleshoot it?
questions.reference: Check these prerequisites: your hosting or email plan is active; your domain is registered and activated; the correct Hostinger Email MX records are in your DNS zone (plus SPF and DKIM for deliverability); the email account has actually been created; and mail services are enabled. Note that a new domain can take up to 24 hours to start working, DNS changes need up to 24 hours to propagate, and email delivery itself can take up to 15 minutes.

questions.question: How do I get a free domain with my Hostinger plan?
questions.reference: A free domain is included when you buy a new eligible plan (Web Premium, Web Business, Cloud hosting, KVM VPS, or Business Premium Email) with a 12-month or longer billing period. It covers one year of registration for an eligible TLD (KVM plans only include .cloud or .tech). Claim it from the hPanel home page via the Claim Domain button, or during plan setup. The domain must be claimed within 12 months of purchase and verified within 15 days of registration. Free domains are non-refundable.

questions.question: I see a 'Domain not connected to your website' error in hPanel. How do I fix it?
questions.reference: If the domain is registered at Hostinger in the same account, it connects automatically within minutes. Domains from other registrars must be connected manually by pointing them to Hostinger. Common causes: the domain was just registered (wait a few hours); DNS propagation is still in progress (up to 24 hours); wrong A/CNAME values (AI Builder manual mode needs CNAME records, other sites need the A record matching your hosting IP); the domain is not verified (verify within 15 days or it may be suspended); DNSSEC is enabled at your registrar and must be disabled.

questions.question: How long does it take to transfer a domain to Hostinger?
questions.reference: A domain transfer usually takes 5 to 7 days. The exact time depends on your current registrar and the domain's TLD; in rare cases some TLDs take more than 7 days. You can check the transfer status anytime in the Domains section of hPanel.

questions.question: How do I get the EPP (authorization) code to transfer my domain away from Hostinger?
questions.reference: Go to the Domains section of hPanel and click Manage next to the domain. The authorization code is shown in the Domain Overview section; click Get code to view it. Transfer requirements: more than 60 days since registration or the last transfer, the domain must be unlocked, and privacy protection must be disabled. Some TLDs have special rules (e.g. .uk uses an IPS tag instead).

questions.question: What is Hostinger's refund policy?
questions.reference: Hostinger offers a 30-day money-back guarantee on new purchases and renewals of web, cloud, Agency, KVM VPS, and Game Panel hosting plans, plus Hostinger Email and Titan Email. Non-refundable items include domain renewals, completed domain transfers, domain redemption fees, Google Workspace Email, cryptocurrency payments, and most country-code domain registrations (e.g. .uk, .in, .fr, .ca). New .com/.net/.org registrations are refundable only within 96 hours. If a refunded plan included a free domain, the domain's standard price is deducted from the refund.

questions.question: How do I disable auto-renewal for my Hostinger services?
questions.reference: Go to Profile, then Billing in hPanel, open the Subscriptions tab, find the service, and click the toggle switch to disable auto-renewal. Confirm your choice on the warning page. Your service stays active until its expiration date; disabling auto-renewal does not refund charges already processed. To change your billing cycle instead, auto-renewal must stay enabled.

questions.question: How does Hostinger Agent pricing work? Is support really free?
questions.reference: Support-related requests (troubleshooting, account management, service setup) are free. Business-related requests (strategy, outreach, brand work) consume Agent credits based on complexity. New users get a free trial with 200 credits; after that, subscriptions (1, 3, or 12 month billing) include 1,000 credits per month with 150+ skills, app integrations, and image generation.

questions.question: What can Hostinger Agent actually do for me?
questions.reference: Hostinger Agent is a unified AI assistant (it absorbed the former Kodee chatbot). It can troubleshoot hosting issues, add/update/delete DNS records, manage domains and subdomains, restart or configure a VPS, start website migrations, and build a website via AI Builder directly from chat. Irreversible actions show a confirmation card before proceeding. It also works over WhatsApp, connects to 1000+ apps, generates images, keeps long-term memory, and paid users can switch between Fast and Advanced response modes.
